correctness.rationale: The bijection encoding is exhaustive; two matchings differ on four duads iff their difference is one alternating octagon because there are no 4-cycles. A flip composes with an odd 4-cycle. I reconstructed the graph directly from the six symbols, using least-choice matching enumeration and explicit cycles in the duad projection (each line between consecutive duads is uniquely determined; reject repeated lines). It gives no 4- or 6-cycles and 90 distinct octagons, each alternating in exactly 32 states. Replacing either alternating assignment gives a reciprocal neighbor and yields 288 matchings, degree 10 and 1440 undirected flips. Layer expansion from each state proves connectedness and gives 144 even states of profile (1,10,45,97,96,37,2) and 144 odd states of profile (1,10,42,97,101,37), hence radius 5, diameter 6, and non-vertex-transitivity. Applying all 720 symbol permutations to one representative of each parity gives precisely its 144-member class. Traversing all 4-cycles once using minimum start and an orientation test gives 4320. The reconstructed state and neighbor lists agree with the full frozen certificate; girth 8 excludes all earlier possible moves. Replay: python3 /workspace/branches/local_exact_audit.py 5.
